notablePrerequisites:
Mindsplice Apparatus has at least three oil counters on it.
Pentad Prism has at least one charge counter on it.
description:
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {U}, putting a charge counter on Pentad Prism and returning Clockspinning to your hand.
Activate Pentad Prism by removing a charge counter from it, adding {U}.
Repeat.
